== Card credits ==
Adam Fletcher is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] for the original concept of four cards.<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The cards are in [[Virtual Set 13]], [[Virtual Set 17]], [[Virtual Set 18]] and [[Virtual Set 22]], sets released from 2020 to 2023.
Four cards in all (Concept: 4).<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9" /> The tables give each card, its side, its set and the set's release date, the card it was made from (the title in the strip along the card's bottom edge, when it differs), and the credit exactly as printed. The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Adam Fletcher|Adam Fletcher]] on the Card Credits page.<ref name="cardcredits">[[Card Credits]], SWCCG Wiki (generated from card_labels.json at commit 0bc4377d9).</ref>
